javax.microedition.theme
Interface SkinListener

public interface SkinListener

Listener interface for applications interested in skin related events in the system. By listening to these events an application can detect when its skin has changed, in order to repaint any user interface elements that are dependent on skin changes, such as custom components.

Method Detail

skinActivated

void skinActivated(Skin newSkin,
                   Skin oldSkin)

Called when a skin is activated for some application. The following table explains the semantics of the parameter values:

Activation parameters
newSkinoldSkinMeaning
nullnullSkin activation failed, no previous skin
nullnon-nullReturned to skinless, had previous skin
non-nullnullSkin activation succeeded, no previous skin
non-nullnon-nullSkin activation succeeded, had previous skin

Parameters:
newSkin - the activated skin, or null if activation failed or application returned to default skinless state
oldSkin - the skin that was previously active (null if no skin was active)

skinCreated

void skinCreated(Skin skin)

Called when a new skin has been created for an application. If the skin creation failed, the skin argument must to signal the error.

Parameters:
skin - the new skin, or null if creation failed

skinModified

void skinModified(Skin skin)

Called when a skin of an application skin has been modified.

Parameters:
skin - the modified skin instance

skinRemoved

void skinRemoved(java.lang.String name,
                 ThemeMetadata info)

Called when a skin of an application skin has removed. Because the actual contents of the skin are not relevant after the skin has been removed, the listener application is supplied with metadata about the removed skin instead of an actual skin instance.

Parameters:
name - the unique name of the skin, or null if removal failed
info - a copy of the metadata from the removed skin
